Global multipliers on top of all the other data. study_power scales every study reward. Tuned 1 Nov: no study = dies in round 1-2; quiz every 5-10s = several rounds. 1 Nov: enemy_damage 0.1 -> 0.2 because Flash now moves and dodges.

Flash scores 16 directions every decide_every seconds and takes the safest. preferred_range is a fraction of his longest weapon range (melee builds move in, ranged builds hang back). fear = how much he avoids skeletons; trap_fear = how much he avoids being boxed in.

Keeps rounds tense. Raises intensity (more, tougher, harder-hitting skeletons) while Flash is comfortable; backs off (never below 1 = normal) when he's struggling. The cap grows each round. Below danger_hp the game shows 'answer a quiz to heal him'. Last final_surge_seconds of a round spawn faster.

Word gems: up to max_pairs Thai/English pairs drift in the arena (a new pair every spawn_every s, each lives life s, drifting at speed). Pop quiz: over the lesson after about pop_quiz_every_words words read and at least pop_quiz_min_seconds apart; each one closed without answering doubles the wait, up to pop_quiz_max_backoff times. Rescue: when Flash is in danger a question appears in the game column (another after a right answer, up to rescue_chain), at most every rescue_cooldown s. slow_motion = game speed while a question is open.
